interventions.description: The intervention is about an isocaloric diet that differs in terms of distribution of carbohydrates and protein throughout the day. The interventions include a HP-breakfast and a HC-dinner vs. a HC-breakfast and a HP-dinner. A HP low-carb meal (breakfast or dinner) will contain 35%E protein, 35%E carbs, and 30%E fat, and a HC meal (breakfast or dinner) will contain 10%E protein, 60%E carbs, and 30%E fat.
interventions.name: Diet with specific macronutrient composition.

keywords: Prevention and treatment of type 2 diabetes

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The overall aim is to identify the dietary pattern for prevention and treatment of type 2 diabetes. The specific aim of this pilot project is to compare effects of two diets with different diurnal distribution of carbohydrates and protein on the glucose metabolism in subjects with prediabetes and type 2 diabetes and its effects on inflammatory status.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Overweight individual with prediabetes and non-insulin treated type 2 diabetes will be recruited for the study. The trial will have a cross-over design and compare metabolic effects of two isocaloric 4-week interventions with opposite timely distribution of macronutrient intake - a high-protein (HP) breakfast and a high-carb (HC) dinner (HP/HC intervention) vs. a HC breakfast and a HP dinner (HC/HP intervention) - divided by a 4-week wash-out phase. A HP low-carb meal (breakfast or dinner) will contain 35%E protein, 35%E carbs, and 30%E fat, and a HC meal (breakfast or dinner) will contain 10E%protein, 60%E carbs, and 30%E fat.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Prediabetes (fasting blood sugar 100-125 mg/dl)
* Diabetes type 2 (fasting blood sugar \>126 mg/dl)
* Overweight and obesity (BMI 25-50 kg/m2)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Other diabetes types
* Insulin treatment
* Shift work
* Weight changes \>5% within past 3 months
* Systemic glucocorticoid therapy
* Systemic infections
* Severe anemia
* High blood pressure (\>180/110 mmHg)
* Endocrinologic, liver and heart disorders
* Immune diseases
* Thyroid dysfunction
* Heart attack or stroke
* Cancer in the last 2 years
* Eating disorders, food intolerance/allergy, addiction disorders, digestive disorders intestinal, liver, cardiovascular diseases
* Hereditary or acquired coagulation disorders
* Non-interruptible intake of blood thinners (anticoagulants)
* Specific diets, intermittent fasting
* Pregnancy or breastfeeding
* Severe internal or psychiatric disorders or other conditions and drugs therapy that might influence the outcome of the study

secondaryOutcomes.description: Systolic and diastolic blood pressure changes measurement by manometer
Body fat and lean mass assessed by bioelectrical impendance analysis (BIA)
Energy expenditure and substrate oxidation rates assessed by indirect calorimetry
secondaryOutcomes.measure: Energy expenditure and substrate oxidation rates

secondaryOutcomes.description: GGT, AST, ALT etermined in fasting blood samples
secondaryOutcomes.measure: Hepatic values (gamma-glutamyl transferase (GGT), aspartate aminotransferase (AST), alanine aminotransferase (ALT))

secondaryOutcomes.description: Renal values determined in fasting blood samples
Indices of intra- and inter-day glycemic variability assessed by continuous glucose monitoring (CGM)
Glucose levels in blood samples collected in MTT
secondaryOutcomes.measure: Glucose levels in meal tolerance test (MTT)

secondaryOutcomes.description: Blood levels of metabolic hormones assessed in fasting state and during the MTT

24-h physical activity will be monitored by an ActiGraph device
RNA-Seq analysis of subcutaneous adipose tissue sample
Expression of metabolic genes assessed by qPCR

Impulsiveness assessed by decision making tasks on computer
